decontamination: evaluation_query_texts is EMPTY in this build on purpose: the 4,000 evaluation rows' query text may not be read without a model-free ledger row, so the 6-gram decontamination against the evaluation roster is performed by the flight agent under its own row. Every note word is already constrained to the registry columns of its own target, which the builder enforces.

token_method: ESTIMATE, not a measurement: rendered characters divided by 3.989, the chars-per-token ratio ORG-1 measured on this exact registry and tokenizer (+347 rendered characters = +87 text tokens, 2026-09-05 verdict section 5). The exact count comes from the resident server's /tokenize route at prompt fit, which no model-free step may start; the flight agent measures it before takeoff.
